{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**Seven people are injured after a rocket attack destroys a home in [[Mishmeret]], [[Israel]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] confirm that [[Hamas]] was responsible for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47689684 (BBC)]
**As a result, [[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] cuts his four-day trip to the United States short after meeting with [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/netanyahu-cuts-short-u-s-trip-after-rocket-attack-from-gaza-idUSKCN1R60M3 (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/gaza-rocket-hits-israeli-home-injuring-7-netanyahu-cuts-short-washington-trip/2019/03/25/7eb5f062-4ed0-11e9-a3f7-78b7525a8d5f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[Israeli Air Force]] jets strike multiple targets in the [[Gaza Strip]], including the office of senior [[Hamas]] official [[Ismail Haniyeh]], and Hamas' military intelligence headquarters in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palsetinians-violence-haniyeh/israel-air-strike-targets-office-of-hamas-leader-in-gaza-hamas-radio-idUSKCN1R62BJ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/israeli-military-begins-striking-hamas-targets-gaza-190325152429228.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Flash flooding]] in the southern provinces of [[Iran]] kills at least 17 people and injures more than 70. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-floods-casualties/floods-kill-at-least-17-in-southern-iran-after-causing-disaster-in-the-north-idUSKCN1R61BP (Reuters)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iran-floods-rain-deaths-politics-tehran-waters-weather-a8838691.html (''The Independent'')]

;Health and environment
*[[Bayer]] and [[Johnson & Johnson]] announce that they have reached a $775 million agreement to settle approximately 25,000 outstanding litigation cases, which claim that their drug [[Xarelto]] caused severe and sometimes fatal bleeding episodes. Bayer and Johnson & Johnson had successfully defended the safety of the drug in all six prior cases that went to trial. [https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2019/03/25/xarelto-bayer-johnson-and-johnson-lawsuits/ (Stat)]

;International relations
*[[United States recognition of Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights]], [[Israel–United States relations]], [[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs a proclamation formally recognising the disputed [[Golan Heights]] as sovereign [[Israel]]i territory. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/trump-formally-recognises-israeli-sovereignty-golan-heights-190325153937336.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Syria]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (Syria)|Foreign Affairs Ministry]] condemns Trump's move as a "flagrant violation of the sovereignty of Syria". [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-03/26/c_137923014.htm (Xinhuanet)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp|Guantanamo Bay]] prisoner [[Omar Khadr]] completes his prison sentence. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5068610 (CBC)] [https://www.vancourier.com/edmonton-judge-rules-omar-khadr-s-sentence-has-expired-1.23769542 (Vancouver Courier)]
*Attorney [[Michael Avenatti]] is arrested and charged with extortion, embezzlement and bank fraud. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/25/michael-avenatti-to-be-charged-with-wire-and-bank-fraud.html (CNBC)]
